readiness_evidence: First release on PyPI; there is no earlier installed version to be compatible with.

A paid booking passed end to end on 16/10/2026 with the release candidate: Link sign-in, search area, discovery, native checkout, slot selection, buyer from Link, booking, spend approval, and confirmation.
releases.user_summary: First public release of the booking assistant.

readiness_evidence: No request or response exchanged with the registry or with businesses changes: the platform profile, USP and UCP versions, and every booking call are as in 0.1.0.
The saved booking file keeps format 2. The only new field is optional and at the top level, which 0.1.0 ignores, so moving between 0.1.0 and 0.2.0 in either direction keeps every saved booking.
The full test suite passes, including new tests for older and newer saved bookings and for the update consent, decline, and install paths.
releases.user_summary: The booking assistant can now tell you when a newer version is ready and install it when you agree.

readiness_evidence: PyPI serves PEP 740 provenance for both published files: the integrity endpoint returns HTTP 200 for booking_agent_cli-0.3.0-py3-none-any.whl and booking_agent_cli-0.3.0.tar.gz, the publisher is GitHub wix/booking-agent workflow release.yml, and pypi-attestations verify pypi --repository https://github.com/wix/booking-agent prints OK for both. gh attestation verify --repo wix/booking-agent also passes for the wheel.

A clean uv tool install of 0.3.0 from PyPI passes its own first-run check against the live provenance on the first flow init. After one installed file was edited, flow init and flow pay request refused with installation_unverified and a reinstall command; restoring the file cleared it.
No request or response exchanged with the registry or with businesses changes: the platform profile, USP and UCP versions, and every booking call are as in 0.2.0.

Saved bookings move both ways: with one session file, 0.2.0 started a booking, 0.3.0 listed it and added another, 0.2.0 then read the file and added a third while keeping the two new optional fields, and 0.3.0 read all three. The file keeps format 2.
releases.user_summary: The booking assistant now checks that updates and its own installation come from the official release before it books or pays.
The booking assistant now checks that its own instructions are the official ones before it books or pays.
